keep_hidden includes hidden elements and template text in HTTP Markdown output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'never' }, 'content' => { 'extract_metadata' => false, 'keep_hidden' => true } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.markdown.content.inspect
```
